verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no Supabase policy, setting, or opt-out about using customer data or AI Assistant inputs to train AI models. The nearby items are adjacent controls and do not count for this story: CLI usage-telemetry opt-out, self-hosting for 'full control over your data', and SOC 2/HIPAA compliance. A data platform with an embedded AI assistant could plausibly offer such a control, so the axis applies and the verdict is none rather than na.
